name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: A page-wide custom cursor that follows the pointer on a spring and leans into the direction of travel.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Custom cursor element. Defaults to an arrow with a soft shadow.

props.name: springConfig
props.type: { damping: number; stiffness: number; mass: number; restDelta: number }
props.description: Spring used to follow the pointer. Rotation and scale use stiffer variants of it.
